description: Java source file defining a REST API resource for self scorecard operations within the Fineract platform, including methods for retrieving and creating scorecards with client validation.

classes.name: SelfScorecardApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing self scorecards, including retrieval and creation with client validation.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Retrieves scorecards for a specific client after validating client-user mapping.

methods.name: createScorecard
methods.description: Creates a new scorecard for a survey, validating client-user mapping if clientId is provided.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates that the authenticated user is mapped to the specified client ID, throws exception if not.
